metadata.capability_extraction: Can select all text, navigate Format > Text menu, apply case transformations including Sentence case, and save the document.
metadata.explanation: Alternate case transformation: agent must apply Sentence case (Format > Text > Sentence case) to all text. Sentence case capitalizes the first letter of each paragraph and lowercases everything else. Evaluator verifies that for every non-empty paragraph and table cell, the first alpha char is uppercase and all remaining alpha chars are lowercase. [Fixed: removed nested helper function '_analyze_text_block' entirely and inlined the sentence-case logic directly in the loop — the validator flags any function definition in getter files that does not start with 'get_', so the solution is to have no nested function at all.]
fix_history: Fix 1: Renamed inner helper function 'check_text_block' to 'get_text_block' in getters/writer.py — validator requires all function definitions in getter files to start with 'get_'
Fix 2: Renamed inner local helper 'get_text_block' to '_analyze_text_block' in getters/writer.py — local helper functions must NOT start with 'get_' to avoid MD5 hash suffix validation errors

Fix 3: Removed nested '_analyze_text_block' function definition entirely and inlined its logic directly in the iteration loop — eliminates the validation error since no non-get_ function is defined in the getter file

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly downloads the saved .docx file and parses both body paragraphs and table cells, matching the instruction's scope ('all text in the document').

Sentence case logic is semantically correct: first alphabetic character of each text block is checked for uppercase, all remaining alpha characters are checked for lowercase — exactly matching the instruction definition.
Postconfig performs Ctrl+S and waits 2 seconds before evaluation, ensuring the saved file state is verified rather than in-memory state.
Metric correctly returns 1.0 only when ALL text blocks pass both checks (first_upper_ok == total_blocks AND rest_lower_ok == total_blocks), enforcing strict sentence case throughout the document.
Error handling covers file-not-found and empty-document edge cases adequately.

Minor issue: table cells use cell.text which concatenates multiple paragraphs within a cell into one string — internal paragraph boundaries within multi-paragraph table cells are not individually sentence-case checked, which could miss violations in complex tables.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: For more granular table cell verification, consider iterating cell.paragraphs instead of using cell.text, so that each paragraph within a table cell is individually checked for sentence case compliance.
